tracked_object_initialization: Only frame zero, further locally registered to frame zero RGB; later source object transforms used solely for comparisons
retained_data: Per-frame source human mesh, shared source object scale, fixed mesh appearance/camera
search: 32 rotation proposals per parent per local or expanded pass; loose projected-box filter; <=8 full-color survivors; retain up to four endpoint-diverse trajectories; derivative-free local refinement
motion_prior: Acceleration only; linear and angular weights 0.01. No speed penalty or absolute rotation clamp.
earlier_trials: v1 failed due recursive non-orthogonal matrix extrapolation, corrected
v2 demonstrated wrong constant spin with weight 1
v3 added first-image registration, candidate diversity and image translation proposals; weight 1 still lost tracking
interpretation: Parameter-tuning trial on one clip, not an official GT evaluation or a controlled runtime speedup benchmark
